description: Nestled in a highly desirable pocket of Tarzana just south of Ventura Boulevard, this fully renovated single-story home offers a perfect balance of modern elegance, comfort, style, excellent public schools, and everyday functionality. Offering 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 1,662 square feet, the home sits on an approximately 6,000-square-foot lot framed by mature trees and a welcoming front lawn. Outdoor living is elevated with a pool whose surface and tile were recently refinished, along with a backyard patio designed for gatherings, dining, or quiet evenings at home. The interior has been thoughtfully reimagined with contemporary finishes throughout, including engineered wood flooring, upgraded interior and exterior lighting, dual-pane windows, a new electric fireplace, a new metal driveway gate, new exterior and interior doors, and a redesigned kitchen with modern cabinetry, brand-new appliances, generous storage, and a central waterfall-style island that anchors the open-concept layout. Both bathrooms have been tastefully renovated to reflect today’s design standards. The spacious primary retreat offers privacy, an ensuite bath, and an oversized walk-in closet, while three additional rooms can easily adapt to changing needs such as guest accommodations, workspace, or family living. Recent system upgrades include improvements to the HVAC, roof, and water heater for added peace of mind. A detached two-car garage has been finished for flexible use as a fitness area, studio, or office, while also presenting future ADU possibilities. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, recreation, and commuter routes, with access to highly regarded local schools, this property represents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy the best of Valley living in a sought-after residential setting.
